facts.fact: Government representatives told parliament's administration committee that the public procurement system is online, with more than 27,700 bids registered online and 15,500 suppliers and contractors.

Government representatives said the online public procurement system was adopted gradually from 2012 to 2014, tested, then made general and compulsory for all ministries and public institutions in 2019.
Government representatives gave a figure of more than 27,700 bids registered on the online public procurement system, with 15,500 suppliers and 1,441 public buyers registered.

TUN.note: Nothing on digital financial consumer protection.

facts.fact: Government representatives listed public systems online, including the Allysa system, public procurement and school and university registration, plus the Tunisian government portal; no count of services is given.
